"};

function applyPhotoLayout(el,photo){if(!el||!photo)return;el.style.objectFit=photo.fit==='full'?'contain':'cover';el.style.objectPosition=`${Math.min(100,Math.max(0,Number(photo.focusX??50)))}% ${Math.min(100,Math.max(0,Number(photo.focusY??50)))}%`;}

 const info=el('div','place-copy');info.append(el('p','place-label label',(v.role||'Lugar').toUpperCase()));info.append(el('h3','place-name serif',v.name));

 if(v.address)info.append(el('p','place-address',v.address)); if(i===0 && CONF.dressCode?.enabled && CONF.dressCode.text)info.append(el('p','place-address guest-dresscode','Código de vestimenta · '+CONF.dressCode.text));
 const btn=el('a','place-link','Cómo llegar');btn.href=v.directions||'#';btn.addEventListener('click',event=>{if(!v.directions){event.preventDefault();notice('Cómo llegar','Aquí se abrirá el enlace de ubicación configurado en el pedido.')}});if(v.directions||!CONF.schemaResolved)info.append(btn);
   if(v.websiteUrl){try{const target=new URL(v.websiteUrl);if(['http:','https:'].includes(target.protocol)){const siteLink=el('a','place-link guest-place-website','Sitio web');siteLink.href=target.href;siteLink.target='_blank';siteLink.rel='noopener noreferrer';siteLink.style.marginLeft=v.directions?'8px':'0';info.append(siteLink)}}catch{}}

 $('agenda').hidden=!CONF.agenda?.length;
 // GUEST real questionnaire contract: bus, accommodation, gift and playlist. No extra subtitle fields.
 const pc=CONF.practical && !Array.isArray(CONF.practical)?CONF.practical:{};

 const usableUrl=(u)=>{try{const z=new URL(u);return ['https:','http:'].includes(z.protocol)}catch{return false}};
 const isDemo=(u)=>/^https?:\/\/example\.(com|org|net)(?:\/|$)/i.test(u||'');
 function action(label,url){
   if(!usableUrl(url))return null;

   if(isDemo(url))a.addEventListener('click',ev=>{ev.preventDefault();notice(label,'Este enlace es de demostración. Se sustituye automáticamente por el enlace facilitado en el cuestionario.')});
   return a;

 function details(label,message){const b=el('button','atelier-action',label);b.type='button';b.addEventListener('click',()=>notice(label,message));return b}
 function note(category,title,summary,actions=[],extras=[]){
   const kind=({TRANSPORTE:'transport',ALOJAMIENTO:'hotel','MÚSICA':'music',REGALO:'gift'}[category]||'other');

       timetable.append(cell);

     if(timetable.childElementCount)body.append(timetable);
     if(bus.note)body.append(copy(bus.note,'v11-note'));
     if(buttons.length){const bar=el('div','v11-transport-actions');buttons.forEach((b,i)=>bar.append(makeAction(b,i?'link':'link')));body.append(bar)}
   }else if(kind==='hotel'){

     body.append(name);
     if(hotel.note)body.append(copy(hotel.note,'v11-note'));
     const main=buttons.find(b=>/^(ver hotel|reservar)$/i.test((b.textContent||'').trim()))||buttons.find(b=>b.tagName==='A')||buttons[0];
     const detail=buttons.find(b=>/^(información|condiciones|detalles)$/i.test((b.textContent||'').trim()));
     const row=el('div','v11-hotel-actions');
     if(main)row.append(makeAction(main,'primary'));
     if(detail&&detail!==main)row.append(makeAction(detail,'link'));
     buttons.filter(b=>b!==main&&b!==detail).forEach(b=>row.append(makeAction(b,'link')));
     if(row.childElementCount)body.append(row);
   }else if(kind==='music'){
     body.append(eyebrow(),heading(title));
     if(summary)body.append(copy(summary));
     if(buttons.length){const row=el('div','v11-music-actions');buttons.forEach((b,i)=>row.append(makeAction(b,i?'link':'secondary')));body.append(row)}
   }else if(kind==='gift'){
     body.append(eyebrow());
     const intro=el('div','v11-gift-intro');intro.append(heading(title));
     if(buttons.length){const bar=el('div','v11-gift-actions');buttons.forEach((b,i)=>bar.append(makeAction(b,i?'link':'primary')));intro.append(bar)}
     body.append(intro);
     if(summary)body.append(copy(summary));
   }else{
     body.append(eyebrow(),heading(title));
     if(summary)body.append(copy(summary));
     buttons.forEach((b,i)=>body.append(makeAction(b,i?'link':'primary')));
   }
   extras.filter(Boolean).forEach(x=>body.append(x));card.append(body);pr.append(card);
 }
 const bus=pc.bus;
 if(bus?.enabled){
   const chunks=[];if(bus.pickupPoints?.length)chunks.push('Parada'+(bus.pickupPoints.length>1?'s':'')+': '+bus.pickupPoints.join(' · '));
   if(bus.outboundTimes?.length)chunks.push('Ida '+bus.outboundTimes.join(' · '));
   if(bus.returnTimes?.length)chunks.push('Vuelta '+bus.returnTimes.join(' · '));
   const busAction=action('Ver parada',bus.mapsUrl);

 }
 const hotel=pc.accommodation;
 if(hotel?.enabled && hotel.mode!=='none'){
   const short=[hotel.name,hotel.note].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
   const meta=[];

   if(hotel.mode==='external_booking' && usableUrl(hotel.externalBookingUrl))actions.push(action('Reservar',hotel.externalBookingUrl));
   else if(usableUrl(hotel.websiteUrl))actions.push(action('Ver hotel',hotel.websiteUrl));
   else if(usableUrl(hotel.externalBookingUrl))actions.push(action('Reservar',hotel.externalBookingUrl));
   if(meta.length)actions.push(details('Información',meta.join('\n')));
   if(usableUrl(hotel.mapsUrl))actions.push(action('Cómo llegar',hotel.mapsUrl));
   note('ALOJAMIENTO','Dónde descansar',short,actions);
 }
 const playlist=pc.playlist;
 if(playlist?.enabled && playlist.mode!=='none'){
   const playlistTarget=usableUrl(playlist.url)?playlist.url:(playlist.mode==='guest_request'&&usableUrl(CONF.rsvpUrl)?CONF.rsvpUrl:null);
   const playlistButton=playlistTarget?action(playlist.mode==='guest_request'?'Proponer canción':'Abrir playlist',playlistTarget):null;
   note('MÚSICA','Vuestra canción',playlist.prompt||'',[playlistButton]);
 }
 const gift=pc.gift;
 if(gift?.enabled && gift.mode!=='none'){
   const act=[];
   if(gift.mode==='external_link'){if(usableUrl(gift.externalUrl))act.push(action(gift.linkLabel||'Ver lista',gift.externalUrl))}
   else if(gift.mode==='bank'){
     const items=[gift.accountHolder&&'Titular: '+gift.accountHolder,gift.iban&&'IBAN: '+gift.iban,gift.bicSwift&&'BIC/SWIFT: '+gift.bicSwift].filter(Boolean);
     if(items.length||gift.details)act.push(details('Ver datos',items.join('\n')||gift.details));
   } else if(gift.mode==='bizum'){
     const items=[gift.bizumRecipient&&'Destinatario: '+gift.bizumRecipient,gift.bizumPhone&&'Bizum: '+gift.bizumPhone].filter(Boolean);
     if(items.length||gift.details)act.push(details('Ver datos',items.join('\n')||gift.details));
   }
   else if(gift.mode==='short_text' && gift.details) { /* the message is visible, no duplicate popup */ }
   const message=gift.mode==='short_text'?(gift.details||gift.displayText||''):(gift.displayText||'');
   note('REGALO','Con cariño',message,act);
 }
 $('practical').hidden=!pr.childElementCount;
 const gal=$('galleryTrack');gal.replaceChildren();(CONF.gallery||[]).forEach((item,i)=>{const f=el('figure','gallery-shot');const im=el('img');im.src=typeof item==='string'?item:item.src;im.alt=(typeof item==='object'&&item.alt)||'Recuerdo '+(i+1)+' de la pareja';im.loading='lazy';applyPhotoLayout(im,typeof item==='string'?null:item);f.append(im);gal.append(f)});$('gallery').hidden=!CONF.gallery?.length;
 $('galleryHint').textContent=(CONF.gallery||[]).length>1?'Desliza para ver más':'Un recuerdo nuestro';
 const dots=$('galleryDots');dots.replaceChildren();(CONF.gallery||[]).slice(0,8).forEach((v,i)=>dots.append(el('i',i===0?'on':'')));
}
function notice(title,content){$('dialogTitle').textContent=title;$('dialogCopy').textContent=content;$('previewDialog').showModal()}
$('dialogClose').addEventListener('click',()=>$('previewDialog').close());
$('rsvp').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(CONF.rsvpUrl){window.location.assign(CONF.rsvpUrl)}else{notice('Confirmar asistencia','Esta es una prueba visual. La invitación comercial conectará este botón al RSVP existente de GUEST para el destinatario correspondiente.')}});
$('galleryTrack').addEventListener('scroll',()=>{const g=$('galleryTrack');const idx=Math.round(g.scrollLeft/(g.firstElementChild?.getBoundingClientRect().width+14||1));[...$('galleryDots').children].forEach((d,i)=>d.classList.toggle('on',i===idx))},{passive:true});
function setupFilm(){for(const id of ['coverVideo','finalVideo']){let v=$(id);v.src=MEDIA.opening;v.load();v.play().catch(()=>{});}
 document.querySelectorAll('.breathVideo').forEach(v=>{v.src=MEDIA.breath;v.load();v.play().catch(()=>{});});const glow=$('glowVideo');if(glow){glow.src=MEDIA.glow;glow.load();glow.play().catch(()=>{});}
}
const STORY_PRESET_COPY={
 'story-01':'Llevamos años compartiendo planes, viajes, domingos tranquilos y muchas risas. Ahora nos hace muchísima ilusión celebrar el siguiente capítulo con vosotros.',
 'story-02':'No sabemos exactamente cuándo empezó todo, pero sí sabemos que desde entonces la vida es mucho más divertida juntos. Y este día no tendría sentido sin vosotros.',
 'story-03':'Entre planes improvisados, viajes, cenas que se alargan y días de sofá, hemos ido construyendo lo nuestro. Ahora toca celebrarlo con nuestra gente.',
 'story-04':'Después de tantos momentos compartidos, ha llegado uno que queremos vivir rodeados de las personas que forman parte de nuestra historia: vosotros.',
 'story-05':'Nos elegimos hace tiempo y seguimos eligiéndonos cada día. Ahora queremos celebrarlo como más nos gusta: con nuestra familia y amigos cerca.'
};
function fromQuestionnaire(input){
  const canonical=input?.schemaVersion==='guest-invitation-config-v1'||!!(input?.template && input?.couple && input?.wedding && input?.locations && input?.practical);
  if(!canonical)return structuredClone(input);
  const result=structuredClone(DEFAULT);
  result.schemaResolved=true;
  result.couple={first:input.couple.name1,second:input.couple.name2,date:input.wedding.date,city:input.wedding.coverPlace,hour:input.wedding.time||''};
  result.coverShowPlace=input.cover.showPlace;
  result.coverShowTime=input.cover.showTime;
  result.countdownEnabled=input.countdown.enabled;
  result.storyEnabled=input.story.enabled && (input.story.textMode!=='none'||!!(input.story.photo?.src||input.cover.photo?.src));
  const selectedPhoto=(input.story.enabled && input.story.photo?.src?input.story.photo:null) || input.cover.photo || null;
  result.storyPhoto=selectedPhoto?.src||null;result.storyPhotoMeta=selectedPhoto;
  result.copy.story=input.story.body||(input.story.textMode==='preset'?STORY_PRESET_COPY[input.story.presetId]||STORY_PRESET_COPY['story-03']:'');
  result.venues=(input.locations?.items||[]).map(v=>({role:v.type==='ceremony'?'Ceremonia':v.type==='celebration'?'Celebración':'Ceremonia y celebración',name:v.name,hour:v.time,city:input.wedding.coverPlace,address:v.address,photo:input.locations.heroPhoto?.src||null,photoMeta:input.locations.heroPhoto,directions:v.mapsUrl||'',websiteUrl:v.websiteUrl||''}));result.dressCode=input.locations?.dressCode||{enabled:false};
  result.agenda=input.agenda.enabled?input.agenda.moments:[];
  result.practical=input.practical;
  result.gallery=input.gallery.enabled?input.gallery.photos:[];
  result.rsvpUrl=(input.rsvp?.route&&input.rsvp.route!=='#')?input.rsvp.route:'';
  result.rsvpLabel=input.rsvp.ctaLabel;
  result.closingLine=input.closing?.line||null;
  return result;
}
window.BOTANICA_APPLY_CONFIG=(next)=>{CONF=fromQuestionnaire(next);render();return true};
window.BOTANICA_GET_CONFIG=()=>structuredClone(CONF);
setupFilm();render();
</script>
<script id="botanica-agenda-advance">
/* Agenda only: progressive line follows the reader's vertical scrolling. */
(()=>{'use strict';
 const list=document.getElementById('agendaList');
 if(!list)return;
 let scheduled=false;
 const clamp=(v)=>Math.min(1,Math.max(0,v));
 const update=()=>{
   scheduled=false;
   const rows=[...list.querySelectorAll('.score-row')];
   const markers=rows.map(row=>row.querySelector('.score-divider')).filter(Boolean);
   if(!markers.length){list.style.setProperty('--agenda-progress','0');return;}
   const bounds=list.getBoundingClientRect();
   const centers=markers.map(marker=>{const rect=marker.getBoundingClientRect();return rect.top+rect.height/2});
   const first=markers[0].getBoundingClientRect();
   const start=centers[0], end=centers[centers.length-1];
   const height=Math.max(2,end-start);
   list.style.setProperty('--agenda-track-x',((first.left+first.width/2)-bounds.left).toFixed(2)+'px');
   list.style.setProperty('--agenda-track-top',(start-bounds.top).toFixed(2)+'px');
   list.style.setProperty('--agenda-track-height',height.toFixed(2)+'px');
   const reduced=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
   const head=innerHeight*.55;
   const progress=reduced?1:clamp((head-start)/height);
   list.style.setProperty('--agenda-progress',progress.toFixed(3));
   // Activate exactly one title at a time: from one midpoint to the next.
   const entered=reduced || head>=start-60;
   let active=0;
   for(let i=0;i<centers.length-1;i++){
     const midpoint=(centers[i]+centers[i+1])/2;
     if(head>=midpoint)active=i+1;
   }
   rows.forEach((row,i)=>{
     row.classList.toggle('is-passed',i<active);
     row.classList.toggle('is-current',entered && i===active);
   });
 };
 const schedule=()=>{if(!scheduled){scheduled=true;requestAnimationFrame(update)}};
 addEventListener('scroll',schedule,{passive:true});
 addEventListener('resize',schedule,{passive:true});
 new MutationObserver(schedule).observe(list,{childList:true});
 if(document.fonts?.ready)document.fonts.ready.then(schedule).catch(()=>{});
 schedule();
})();
</script>







<script id="botanica-practical-viewport-v6">
(function(){
 const root=document.getElementById('practicalList'); if(!root)return;
 const reveal=()=>{const cards=[...root.querySelectorAll('.atelier-note')];
   if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
     const observer=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)e.target.classList.add('in-view')})},{threshold:.16});
     cards.forEach(c=>observer.observe(c));
   }else cards.forEach(c=>c.classList.add('in-view'));
 };
 const observer=new MutationObserver(reveal);observer.observe(root,{childList:true});reveal();
})();
</script>

<style id="botanica-practico-v12-overrides">
/* V12: compact, clearer Practical without touching approved floral backgrounds. */
#practical{padding-top:clamp(24px,3.6vh,34px)!important;padding-bottom:clamp(34px,5.4vh,48px)!important}
#practical>.inner>h2{margin-bottom:16px!important}
#practical .v11-eyebrow{margin-bottom:6px!important;color:#6f5442!important}
#practical .v11-title{font-size:clamp(34px,8.5vw,43px)!important;line-height:.95!important;color:#443126!important;letter-spacing:-.038em!important;text-wrap:balance}
#practical .v11-copy{font-size:clamp(15px,3.75vw,17px)!important;line-height:1.3!important;color:#40352d!important;max-width:34ch!important;margin-top:6px!important}
#practical .v11-note{font-size:clamp(14px,3.45vw,15px)!important;line-height:1.28!important;color:#4b3d33!important;margin-top:5px!important}
#practical .v11-action{min-height:40px!important;padding:8px 18px!important;font-size:clamp(13px,3.35vw,15px)!important}
#practical .v11-action--primary{min-width:116px!important}
#practical .v11-action--link{min-height:30px!important;padding:4px 0 3px!important}
#practical .v11-transport{padding-bottom:16px!important}
#practical .v11-transport .v11-title{font-size:clamp(31px,8.0vw,39px)!important;white-space:normal!important}
#practical .v11-stop{font-size:clamp(14px,3.55vw,16px)!important;line-height:1.22!important;margin-top:7px!important}
#practical .v11-timetable{margin-top:10px!important;padding-top:10px!important;column-gap:12px!important}
#practical .v11-time-cell+.v11-time-cell{padding-left:12px!important}
#practical .v11-time-label{font-size:clamp(11px,2.8vw,12px)!important}
#practical .v11-time-value{font-size:clamp(19px,5.3vw,24px)!important;line-height:1.02!important}
#practical .v11-hotel{padding:15px 0 16px!important}
#practical .v11-hotel-top{margin-bottom:4px!important;gap:8px 12px!important}
#practical .v11-subtitle{font-size:clamp(18px,4.8vw,22px)!important;color:#7a5d49!important}
#practical .v11-hotel-name{font-size:clamp(31px,8.8vw,44px)!important;line-height:.92!important;letter-spacing:-.048em!important;margin:0!important}
#practical .v11-hotel-name--long{font-size:clamp(29px,8.2vw,39px)!important}
#practical .v11-hotel-actions{margin-top:8px!important;gap:8px 16px!important}
#practical .v12-hotel-name-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px 16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#practical .v12-hotel-inline-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:flex-end;white-space:nowrap;min-height:unset!important;padding:0 0 2px!important;align-self:flex-end}
#practical .v12-hotel-inline-link.v11-action--link{font-size:clamp(13px,3.3vw,15px)!important;border-bottom-width:1px!important}
#practical .v11-music{padding:15px 0 16px!important}
#practical .v11-music .v11-body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;column-gap:14px;align-items:end}
#practical .v11-music .v11-eyebrow,#practical .v11-music .v11-title,#practical .v11-music .v11-copy{grid-column:1}
#practical .v11-music-actions{grid-column:2;grid-row:1 / span 3;align-self:end;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:0!important}
#practical .v11-music .v11-title{font-size:clamp(33px,8.4vw,41px)!important}
#practical .v11-gift{padding:15px 0 0!important}
#practical .v11-gift .v11-body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;column-gap:14px;align-items:end}
#practical .v11-gift-intro{display:contents!important}
#practical .v11-gift .v11-eyebrow,#practical .v11-gift .v11-title,#practical .v11-gift .v11-copy{grid-column:1}
#practical .v11-gift .v11-title{font-size:clamp(34px,8.6vw,42px)!important}
#practical .v11-gift-actions{grid-column:2;grid-row:2 / span 2;align-self:end;justify-content:flex-end}
#practical .v11-gift .v11-copy{max-width:28ch!important}
#practical #practicalList > .v11-item:last-child{padding-bottom:0!important}
#gallery{padding-top:clamp(34px,5vh,48px)!important}
/* V13: a very slight contrast lift only inside Practical, preserving readability and the approved composition. */
#practical{overflow:hidden!important}
#practical::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(58% 42% at 84% 18%, rgba(118,97,81,.11) 0%, rgba(118,97,81,.07) 22%, rgba(118,97,81,0) 58%),
    radial-gradient(54% 44% at 18% 64%, rgba(131,112,96,.09) 0%, rgba(131,112,96,.05) 20%, rgba(131,112,96,0) 56%),
    radial-gradient(48% 34% at 86% 86%, rgba(123,103,87,.06) 0%, rgba(123,103,87,.03) 22%, rgba(123,103,87,0) 54%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.03) 0%, rgba(115,96,79,.035) 36%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 100%);
  mix-blend-mode:multiply;opacity:.88}
#practical>.inner{position:relative;z-index:3}
@media (max-width:370px){
  #practical .v11-music .v11-body,#practical .v11-gift .v11-body{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
  #practical .v11-music-actions,#practical .v11-gift-actions{grid-column:1!important;grid-row:auto!important;justify-content:flex-start!important;margin-top:10px!important}
  #practical .v12-hotel-name-row{align-items:baseline}
}

/* V14: portada separator refined + improved readability for bus times and hotel subtitle. */
.cover .hero-and{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;
  font:italic 500 clamp(27px,7.2vw,36px)/1 var(--serif);
  color:#8a6852;margin:12px 0 10px;letter-spacing:.01em;text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(247,241,232,.55)}
.cover .hero-and::before,.cover .hero-and::after{content:"";display:block;width:30px;max-width:11vw;height:1px;background:rgba(138,104,82,.34)}
#practical .v11-time-label{font-size:clamp(12px,3.05vw,13px)!important;line-height:1.2!important;color:#775b47!important;letter-spacing:.11em!important}
#practical .v11-time-value{font-size:clamp(21px,5.6vw,26px)!important;line-height:1.06!important;color:#4a362b!important;text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(247,241,232,.26)}
#practical .v11-subtitle{font-size:clamp(20px,5vw,24px)!important;line-height:1.04!important;color:#6a5140!important;text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(247,241,232,.24)}
@media (max-width:370px){
  .cover .hero-and{gap:10px;font-size:clamp(24px,6.8vw,31px)}
  .cover .hero-and::before,.cover .hero-and::after{width:24px}
}
</style>
<script id="botanica-practico-v12-script">
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){
  const hotel = document.querySelector('#practical .v11-hotel .v11-body');
  if(hotel && !hotel.querySelector('.v12-hotel-name-row')){
    const name = hotel.querySelector('.v11-hotel-name');
    const actions = hotel.querySelector('.v11-hotel-actions');
    if(name && actions){
      const inline = actions.querySelector('.v11-action--link');
      if(inline){
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        row.className = 'v12-hotel-name-row';
        name.replaceWith(row);
        row.appendChild(name);
        inline.classList.add('v12-hotel-inline-link');
        row.appendChild(inline);
        if(!actions.children.length) actions.remove();
      }
    }
  }
});
</script>

<style id="botanica-v14-4-only-variable-closing">
/* Scalable long custom closing: default V14 closing remains byte-geometry identical. */
.finale-sign .thanks.thanks--custom-long{white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere;max-width:min(88vw,325px);width:100%;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;line-height:1.36;text-align:center;text-wrap:balance}
</style>
<style id="botanica-v14-5-long-date-only">.finale-sign .date.date--adaptive{white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:break-word;text-wrap:balance;max-width:min(88vw,360px);width:100%;font-size:clamp(13px,3.45vw,16px);line-height:1.35;justify-self:center;text-align:center}</style>
</body></html>
